Welcome to my personal academic homepage. I plan to use this notes section for short technical write-ups, paper summaries, derivations, and reproducible examples.

The site is intentionally simple: most updates should involve editing a `.qmd` page, adding a post under `posts/`, or updating the YAML files in `data/`.
